payload.summary: [CRITICAL CHURN BLOCKER] Store Critical: P1 Incident: Root-cause webhook 504 failures & idempotently reconcile 120+ hung orders (TCK-1031)
payload.description: 1) Declare Sev-1 incident; assign incident commander and war-room channel. 2) Root-cause the API gateway/webhook 504 timeouts from the Sept 1 Flash Sale window (gateway logs, upstream payment-provider latency, retry/idempotency configuration); deploy permanent fix with regression tests. 3) Execute idempotent order-state reconciliation for the 120+ hung orders: re-query payment provider for true settlement status, safely flip merchant-side 'unpaid' states to paid where buyer funds were debited, emit corrected webhooks, and prevent duplicate captures/refunds. 4) Produce a chargeback-liability evidence pack for the Sept 1 incident. 5) Stand up webhook monitoring/alerting with p99 latency SLO to prevent recurrence. 6) Hand RCA findings to Commercial for the renewal conversation.
